purpose: Qualify external repositories as benchmark fixtures for scenario classes this project has not covered, using clean clones at pinned revisions with every install, build and test step actually executed.
method: Clean clone, hard checkout of the pinned revision, no local edits.
Install with the repository own lockfile; a dirty worktree after install disqualifies the fixture.
Every declared command runs through src/benchmark-preflight-cli.mjs, which records observed exit codes instead of accepting declared statuses.
Upstream test failures disqualify the fixture. No command is skipped or relaxed to reach eligible.

fixtures.note: Server-side logging library with a layered suite: eslint, a TypeScript transpile step and 545 node:test cases via borp.

React state library whose vitest suite mounts components in jsdom, plus a tsc --noEmit type gate. Installed with pnpm --frozen-lockfile because npm ci rejects the committed package-lock.json at this revision.

rejected.reason: unit tests require Playwright Chromium, which did not install in this environment
upstream suite reported 1259 passing and 1 failing at the pinned revision
pnpm --frozen-lockfile refused the lockfile: overrides configuration mismatch

notes: These fixtures are environment-qualified only. The plan reports scenario coverage per task, so coverage stays cli_tool-only until tasks are authored against these repositories.
